Welcoming rounded silhouette, no loose furniture outside the footprint. Use the supplied two views as massing guidance, enrich with appealing handmade architectural details. Flat grounded bottom. Isolated building only, no ground slab, no landscape, no people, no readable text, no baked shadows, no separate loose props. Cohesive miniature architecture, light matte materials, no dark realistic concrete. Do not create an interior or a cutaway.
